content.text: I'll search the EDR data for PowerShell activity on WKS-1 around 10:02.

input.spl: search source=edr host=WKS-1 process=powershell* earliest=-24h | eval minute=strftime(_time, "%H:%M") | where minute="10:02" | table _time host process command_line parent_process user
input.purpose: Check if WKS-1 ran PowerShell at 10:02
